service.description: The sms-consent provider (org.moqui.comms.ProviderInterfaces sms#Consent), asked by the framework for every sender of a promotional text, the system included: consent true only when a party holding toNumber has PcpSms granted with an internal organization that owns fromNumber (one of its current telecom numbers; that organization's row, else the global one, neither withdrawn) and toNumber has no SMS suppression of every organization or that one; false otherwise. The topic is the ledger's to check, not this hook's. Reads only, with authorization disabled.

A STOP the framework kept (moqui.call.SmsOptOut optedOut Y, lastKeyword STOP): for each internal organization that owns ourNumber, each party holding theirNumber gets a PcpSms withdrawal with it (source PcsSmsReply; once: one already withdrawn there is left) and theirNumber an SMS suppression for it (MsrSmsStop, MssSmsReply; never doubled). Anything else (a START, a HELP) changes nothing: new consent needs new evidence.
